policy.authority: Published SWSE talent mechanics, TXT-first with PDF escalation when material ambiguity exists.
rules: Audit existing tags from the mechanic itself, never from sourcebook, class, prestige class, talent tree, archetype, organization, prerequisites, or flavor alone.
finalTags must use only the surviving Phase 11 184-tag vocabulary unless the owner explicitly authorizes a new ontology concept.
KEEP means existingTags already equal the complete justified finalTags set.
ADD means existing tags are all valid but incomplete.
DELETE means one or more existing tags are unsupported/redundant and no new tags are needed.
ADD_AND_DELETE means the existing array contains unsupported tags and is also missing justified tags.
reliability is reserved for rerolls, take-10/automatic-success, fixed-result, failure-rescue, or comparable outcome stabilization.
condition_removal/recovery describe actual removal or positive recovery, not inflicted or transferred adverse conditions.
sustained_damage requires repeated/ongoing damage-output improvement, not generic control or attack penalties.
Direct attack-roll improvement uses precision; bonus hit points use durability.
Action-type tags pair with action_economy when the talent itself creates or changes action behavior.

assignments.name: Outsider's Eye
assignments.rationale: A once-per-encounter standard-action Perception check reveals tactical information about visible characters or vehicles (a Defense score, hit-point extreme, or condition-track extreme). The mechanic is information gathering/reconnaissance, not mobility, stealth, social interaction, or an attack-roll precision bonus.

assignments.name: Mystical Link
assignments.rationale: A DC 30 Use the Force check as a standard action yields one GM-selected Force-resource benefit: return a Force power, gain a temporary Force Point, gain another use of a limited Force ability, or improve a Force check by rolling an additional die and taking the highest. The old defensive/healing/balance tags are unsupported.

assignments.name: Tripwire
assignments.rationale: The talent uses Mechanics to construct and Deception to conceal a physical trap, requires specific equipment, and produces prone/action-denial and optionally damaging trap effects. Mobility and generic survival are not direct mechanics.

assignments.name: Warrior's Awareness
assignments.rationale: After repeated melee/unarmed attacks from an enemy, a reaction Perception check grants Reflex and Fortitude bonuses against that one selected enemy for the encounter. Nothing in the benefit is Force-related or weapon training.

assignments.name: Galactic Guidance
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, a reaction Knowledge (galactic lore) check lets a nearby ally reroll a failed Intelligence- or Wisdom-based skill check. The direct mechanic is ally skill reliability/support, not movement, positioning, Perception, or social interaction.

assignments.name: Expert Rider
assignments.rationale: The talent simply permits rerolling any Ride check, accepting the second result. Ride/mount/mobility plus reroll reliability describe the mechanic; the Force, damage-reduction, scaling, survival, exploration, and action-economy tags are unsupported.

assignments.name: Rising Panic
assignments.rationale: Ally harm triggers a reaction Use the Force attack against the enemy's Will Defense; success moves the enemy down the condition track and can force fleeing. It inflicts rather than removes conditions and does not increase damage output.

assignments.name: Commander's Prerogative
assignments.rationale: In the first combat round, the user may act before all allies to deploy a qualifying support talent before their turns, then returns to normal initiative. The mechanic is initiative/order setup and team support, not spatial positioning, morale, generic skill use, or sustained damage.

assignments.name: Instrument of the Force
assignments.rationale: A successful Search Your Feelings use grants a temporary Force Point, while use of that point can explicitly increase Dark Side Score. The talent therefore expands available Force resources and directly governs dark-side consequences.

assignments.name: Long Call
assignments.rationale: Long Call improves telepathy DCs for the user and willing Force-user recipients, grants a keep-the-better reroll against unwilling targets, and spends a Force Point to contact a Charisma-scaled number of targets simultaneously.

assignments.name: Forward Patrol
assignments.rationale: At the start of a surprise round when the user is not surprised, one nearby ally retains Dexterity to Reflex Defense. The direct mechanic is surprise-round ally defense; melee/ranged offense, Perception, recon, initiative, mobility, positioning, and overwatch are not part of the benefit.

assignments.name: Draw a Bead
assignments.rationale: Once per round a swift action designates a distant enemy; successful ranged hits against that target add the user's Dexterity bonus to damage until the designation ends. This is a persistent ranged target-designation damage enhancement, not a positioning mechanic.

assignments.name: Precision Shot
assignments.rationale: When aiming, the user gains Point Blank Shot's attack and damage benefit regardless of range. The talent improves aimed ranged accuracy/damage; it does not reduce damage, move the user, or alter action economy.

assignments.name: Get Down
assignments.rationale: When an ally is targeted by a ranged attack, a reaction lets that ally drop prone immediately and impose the normal prone attack penalty on the triggering shot. This is reactive ally ranged defense rather than ambush, initiative, damage, or battlefield-control offense.

assignments.name: Stinging Jab
assignments.rationale: A successful unarmed hit can voluntarily deal half damage to make the target deal half damage with all melee attacks through the next turn. The mechanic is a melee-control tradeoff that reduces incoming damage; it is not a reaction, counterattack, natural-weapon, or generic rider mechanic.

assignments.name: Forewarn Allies
assignments.rationale: All nearby allies gain +2 to attack and damage rolls for attacks of opportunity. This is persistent ally opportunity-attack support with accuracy and damage benefits; it creates no reaction/swift action and has no ambush, initiative, mobility, or positioning mechanic.

assignments.name: Pinning Shot
assignments.rationale: After an aimed damaging ranged attack, the target's speed drops to 2 squares and it cannot double move or run through the next turn. The talent is aimed ranged movement control/stunning; it does not itself use or change a move action.

assignments.name: Seen It All
assignments.rationale: Fear effects used against the character must roll twice and keep the lower result on skill checks and attack rolls. The mechanic is direct fear resistance through adverse roll reliability, not mobility, positioning, generic combat offense, or support.

assignments.name: Cheap Trick
assignments.rationale: When feinting with Deception against a nearby enemy, the user rolls twice and keeps the better result. The talent improves the feint check itself; the prior condition, damage, mobility, weapon-scope, support, and sustained-damage tags are unsupported.

assignments.name: Tested in Battle
assignments.rationale: Whenever the user catches a second wind, they gain its normal hit-point recovery and additionally move +2 steps up the condition track. This is healing/condition recovery, not awareness, mobility, skill use, or altered action economy.

assignments.name: Retaliation Jab
assignments.rationale: When an enemy misses with a melee attack, a reaction automatically deals Strength-modifier damage to that attacker if within reach. The benefit never states that the retaliation is an unarmed/natural-weapon attack, so tree/name-derived martial tags are removed.

assignments.name: Watchful Step
assignments.rationale: Perception replaces the Initiative modifier for Initiative checks, including corresponding rerolls, and the user counts as trained in Initiative. The mechanic is skill substitution plus reroll reliability, not movement, recon support, ambush offense, or damage.

assignments.name: Cover Escape
assignments.rationale: After a Force Point is successfully spent to negate an adjacent ally's attack with Block or Deflect, that ally immediately moves up to 2 squares without provoking. The existing `force` tag is valid but materially incomplete.

assignments.name: Closed Mind
assignments.rationale: Mind-affecting attacks/checks against Will are rolled twice and the lower result is used; this is defensive reroll reliability, not condition removal or generic Force capacity/training.

assignments.name: Esoteric Technique
assignments.rationale: Spending a Force Point on a Force technique/secret grants class-level-scaled bonus hit points for the encounter.

assignments.name: Soothing Presence
assignments.rationale: Automatically improves an unfriendly beast's attitude to indifferent with no check; the mechanic is beast-focused social control with automatic reliability.

assignments.name: Guardian Spirit
assignments.rationale: Enhances Search Your Feelings with consequence/destiny information and grants a restricted daily bonus Force Point for powers, techniques, or secrets.

assignments.name: Vital Encouragement
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, a free action grants heroic-level-scaled bonus hit points; bonus HP are durability, not healing.

assignments.name: Heal Droid
assignments.rationale: Extends vital transfer's healing to droids, directly combining Force-power synergy, droid scope, and healing support.

assignments.name: Telekinetic Strike

assignments.name: Psychic Defenses

assignments.name: Crucial Advice
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, a failed skill check is rerolled with +2; it is self reliability, not ally support or healing.

assignments.name: Force Immersion

assignments.name: Silicon Mind

assignments.name: Link

assignments.name: Jedi Quarry

assignments.name: Shoto Focus

assignments.name: Dark Side Talisman

assignments.name: Sith Alchemy

assignments.name: Suppress Force

assignments.name: Master of the Great Hunt

assignments.name: Enhanced Danger Sense

assignments.name: Channel Energy

assignments.name: Lightsaber Form Savant

assignments.name: Bring Them Back
assignments.rationale: Revivify can reach a dead target for a heroic-level-scaled number of rounds.

assignments.name: Silent Takedown
assignments.rationale: Damaging an unaware target suppresses speech/noise through the next turn as a stunning ambush-control effect.

assignments.name: Force of Will
assignments.rationale: Provides personal Will Defense and can spend a Force Point as a swift action to extend a mind-affecting Will bonus to nearby allies.

assignments.name: Instruction
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a standard action lets an ally make one skill check using the instructor's modifier; repeated selections add uses.

assignments.name: Surprise Strike
assignments.rationale: Failed deceptive information can trigger combat with an immediate surprise-round attack while all other combatants are surprised.

assignments.name: Dirty Fighting
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, damaging a target with melee/ranged lowers its Damage Threshold for the rest of the encounter.

assignments.name: Ion Resistance 10
assignments.rationale: Provides DR 10 against ion damage; the benefit itself is defensive resistance rather than a droid-tree identity tag.

assignments.name: Bothan Resources
assignments.rationale: A Gather Information check unlocks discounted standard, exotic, and restricted equipment/transport through the Spynet.

assignments.name: Second Chance
assignments.rationale: A failed Treat Injury check no longer harms or kills the patient, a direct medical failure-rescue reliability mechanic.

assignments.name: Ion Turret
assignments.rationale: Constructs a turret variant that deals ion damage, specifically useful for electronic/droid control.

assignments.name: Skilled Demolitionist
assignments.rationale: Detonators can be set as a swift action and no longer explode during placement on severe failure.

assignments.name: Cover Bracing
assignments.rationale: Adjacent cover compresses autofire bracing to one swift action and therefore improves braced ranged accuracy/setup.

assignments.name: Reduce Mobility
assignments.rationale: A critical melee/ranged hit halves target speed until fully healed.

assignments.name: Buried Presence
assignments.rationale: A Force Point creates temporary immunity to Force detection/farseeing and may be activated reactively against an attempted location.

assignments.name: Cleanse Mind
assignments.rationale: A swift action removes one ongoing mind-affecting effect from an ally, directly providing Force-based condition recovery.

assignments.name: Modification Specialist
assignments.rationale: Self-reprogramming/modification removes the normal Mechanics/Use Computer penalty; the direct mechanics are droid technical modification/slicing.

assignments.name: Knowledge Is Power
assignments.rationale: A swift galactic-lore analysis designates a target and expands critical threat range against it for the encounter.

assignments.name: Feared Warrior
assignments.rationale: Dropping an enemy enables a free Persuasion fear check that imposes encounter-long attack penalties on nearby targets.

assignments.name: Emergency Team
assignments.rationale: Allies automatically succeed on Aid Another when assisting the user's Treat Injury checks.

assignments.name: Unsettling Presence
assignments.rationale: A Force Point standard action establishes an encounter-long area where failed Will contests cause attack and skill penalties.

assignments.name: Medical Miracle
assignments.rationale: A standard Treat Injury check immediately triggers a target's available second wind, providing direct healing/recovery.

assignments.name: Extreme Explosion
assignments.rationale: Increases mines/explosives blast radius, expanding the controlled area of prepared explosive effects.

assignments.name: Known Dissident
assignments.rationale: A standard Persuasion-vs-Will mind-affecting effect prevents one opponent from attacking the user or occupied vehicle until next turn.

assignments.name: Knowledge Is Strength
assignments.rationale: A swift galactic-lore analysis designates one target and grants encounter-long attack accuracy against it.

assignments.name: Steady Under Pressure
assignments.rationale: Treat Injury checks may reroll and keep the better result, directly improving medical reliability.

assignments.name: Fast Talker
assignments.rationale: Once per day a standard Deception action can take 20 when attempting to deceive.

assignments.name: Surveillance
assignments.rationale: A full-round Perception analysis designates one target and grants the user/allies an attack bonus against it through the next turn.

assignments.name: Forceful Warrior
assignments.rationale: A lightsaber critical hit generates one temporary Force Point for the encounter.

assignments.name: Wrath of the Dark Side
assignments.rationale: A natural-20 Use the Force activation can trade normal Force-power recovery for delayed half-damage on damaged targets.

assignments.name: Slowing Stun
assignments.rationale: Any attack that moves a target down the condition track also halves its speed until all conditions are removed.

assignments.name: Takedown
assignments.rationale: A damaging melee attack at the end of a charge knocks a size-qualified target prone, combining charge positioning with melee control.

assignments.name: Skill Confidence
assignments.rationale: Natural 19–20 skill results trigger Critical Skill Success and Charisma-based bonus hit points; this is skill mastery, critical success, durability, and a follow-up skill setup rather than generic support.

assignments.name: Skill Boon
assignments.rationale: Spending a Force Point on the chosen skill increases the Force Point die type up to d12, directly magnifying that resource for skill performance.

assignments.name: Detective
assignments.rationale: Gather Information used to locate an individual receives a major DC reduction plus lower time and bribery costs, directly supporting investigation/tracking and resource-efficient information gathering.

assignments.name: Skillful Recovery
assignments.rationale: Failure with the chosen skill generates a temporary Force Point usable only on later checks with that skill, creating a failure-triggered skill resource reserve rather than ally support.

assignments.name: Exceptional Skill
assignments.rationale: Chosen-skill d20 results of 2–7 are floored to 8, a direct outcome-stabilizing skill-mastery/reliability mechanic.

assignments.name: Critical Skill Success
assignments.rationale: A natural 20 skill check sets up a +5 bonus to one different skill check before the end of the next turn as a free action.

assignments.name: Advanced Planning
assignments.rationale: At combat initiative, the user and one willing ally swap Initiative results; this is initiative/team planning and setup, not movement or Force mechanics.

assignments.name: Make an Example
assignments.rationale: Exceeding a target's Damage Threshold causes a mind-affecting attack penalty against the user through the next turn, creating defensive battlefield control.

assignments.name: Entangler
assignments.rationale: Improves the user's grab accuracy and worsens the grabbed target's attack penalty until escape, directly strengthening grab/restraint control.

assignments.name: Assured Skill
assignments.rationale: The chosen skill can trade competence bonuses for two d20s and keep either result, a direct reroll reliability mechanic.

assignments.name: Electronic Trail
assignments.rationale: After a target is located, a computer/network reveals its daily electronic movement/spending/browsing trail, supporting electronic tracking and recon.

assignments.name: Pistol Duelist
assignments.rationale: Provides three separate once-per-encounter standard-action pistol modes: halve threshold, gain aiming benefits, or attack while gaining Reflex Defense.

assignments.name: Dedicated Protector
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter designates one ally who gains a morale Reflex Defense bonus while adjacent to the protector for the encounter.

assignments.name: Reliable Boon
assignments.rationale: Force Point dice added to skill checks reroll all 1s until 2+, directly improving Force Point reliability for skill use.

assignments.name: Adept Negotiator
assignments.rationale: A standard-action Persuasion check against Will moves an intelligent enemy down the condition track and can force surrender-like nonaggression at the bottom.

assignments.name: Acrobatic Recovery
assignments.rationale: A DC 20 Acrobatics check prevents an effect from leaving the user prone, directly preserving movement and footing.

assignments.name: Battle Meditation
assignments.rationale: A Force Point full-round activation grants the user and nearby allies an encounter-long attack bonus while they remain in range.

assignments.name: Clear Mind
assignments.rationale: Opposed Use the Force checks made to resist Sense Force can be rerolled, directly improving resistance to Force-based detection.

assignments.name: Dark Side Scourge
assignments.rationale: Melee attacks deal Charisma-based bonus damage against creatures with a Dark Side Score of 1 or higher.

assignments.name: Dark Side Sense
assignments.rationale: Use the Force checks to sense the presence and location of dark-side characters can be rerolled.

assignments.name: Elusive Target
assignments.rationale: While engaged in melee, other opponents take an additional penalty when targeting the user with ranged attacks.

assignments.name: Force Intuition
assignments.rationale: Use the Force replaces Initiative, including eligible rerolls, and can determine starship initiative when the user is the pilot.

assignments.name: Force Persuasion
assignments.rationale: Use the Force replaces Persuasion and inherits eligible Persuasion rerolls.

assignments.name: Master Negotiator
assignments.rationale: Successful Adept Negotiator use moves the target one additional step down the condition track.

assignments.name: Resilience
assignments.rationale: A Force Point spent as a swift action moves the user two positive steps on the condition track.

assignments.name: Skilled Advisor
assignments.rationale: A full-round advisory action grants an ally +5 on the next skill check, or +10 when a Force Point is spent.

assignments.name: Block
assignments.rationale: A reaction Use the Force check with an ignited lightsaber can negate an incoming melee attack.

assignments.name: Deflect
assignments.rationale: A reaction Use the Force check with an ignited lightsaber can negate or reduce qualifying ranged attacks.

assignments.name: Force Haze
assignments.rationale: A Force Point standard action creates a Will-opposed haze that grants total concealment to a class-level-scaled group until broken.

assignments.name: Lightsaber Defense
assignments.rationale: A swift action with an ignited lightsaber grants a scalable deflection bonus to Reflex Defense until the next turn.

assignments.name: Lightsaber Throw
assignments.rationale: The talent enables a standard-action thrown-lightsaber attack and a swift Use the Force check to pull it back within range.

assignments.name: Redirect Shot
assignments.rationale: Once per round after a successful Deflect, the user immediately redirects a single blaster bolt as a ranged attack against another target.

assignments.name: Resist the Dark Side
assignments.rationale: Grants a large Force bonus to all defenses against dark-side Force powers and qualifying dark Force-users.

assignments.name: Weapon Specialization (Lightsabers)
assignments.rationale: Lightsaber melee damage rolls gain a persistent +2 bonus.

assignments.name: Demand Surrender
assignments.rationale: A standard Persuasion check can force a wounded opponent to surrender and cease hostile actions until provoked.

assignments.name: Presence
assignments.rationale: Persuasion intimidation compresses from a full-round action to a standard action.

assignments.name: Bolster Ally
assignments.rationale: A standard action moves a wounded ally up the condition track and grants character-level-scaled bonus hit points, once per ally per encounter.

assignments.name: Born Leader
assignments.rationale: A swift action grants all visible allies a persistent attack bonus while line of sight to the leader is maintained.

assignments.name: Connections
assignments.rationale: Connections provide easier access to restricted equipment and reduce black-market cost multipliers.

assignments.name: Educated
assignments.rationale: Any Knowledge skill can be attempted untrained.

assignments.name: Inspire Confidence
assignments.rationale: A standard action grants allies encounter-long morale bonuses to attack rolls and skill checks.

assignments.name: Inspire Haste
assignments.rationale: A swift action lets an ally perform a normally standard-action skill check as a move action on the next turn.

assignments.name: Inspire Zeal
assignments.rationale: When an ally moves an opponent down the condition track, the target moves one additional step down.

assignments.name: Rally
assignments.rationale: A swift action grants badly wounded allies encounter-long morale bonuses to Reflex and Will defenses and all damage rolls.

assignments.name: Spontaneous Skill
assignments.rationale: Once per day an untrained skill check can be made as though trained, with additional selections adding uses.

assignments.name: Trust
assignments.rationale: The user gives up a standard action to grant an ally an extra standard or move action on its next turn.

assignments.name: Dastardly Strike
assignments.rationale: A successful attack against a target denied Dexterity to Reflex Defense also moves that target down the condition track.

assignments.name: Disruptive
assignments.rationale: Two swift actions suppress enemies' morale and insight bonuses until the next turn.

assignments.name: Fool's Luck
assignments.rationale: A Force Point standard action grants one encounter-long luck bonus to attacks, skills, or all defenses.

assignments.name: Fortune's Favor
assignments.rationale: Scoring a melee or ranged critical hit immediately grants a free standard action during the same turn.

assignments.name: Gambler
assignments.rationale: Wisdom checks made to gamble gain a competence bonus that scales with repeated talent selections.

assignments.name: Knack
assignments.rationale: Once per day a skill check can be rerolled and the better result kept, with additional selections adding uses.

assignments.name: Lucky Shot
assignments.rationale: Once per day an attack roll can be rerolled and the better result kept, with additional selections adding uses.

assignments.name: Skirmisher
assignments.rationale: Moving at least two squares before attacking grants an attack bonus until the next turn.

assignments.name: Sneak Attack
assignments.rationale: Attacks against flat-footed or Dexterity-denied targets deal extra damage, scaling with repeated talent selections.

assignments.name: Gimmick
assignments.rationale: Routine computer commands can be issued as a swift action.

assignments.name: Master Slicer
assignments.rationale: Improve Access Use Computer checks can be rerolled and the better result kept.

assignments.name: Spacehound
assignments.rationale: The user ignores zero-gravity attack penalties and space sickness and is proficient with all starship weapons.

assignments.name: Stellar Warrior
assignments.rationale: A natural 20 on an attack aboard a starship generates a temporary Force Point for the encounter.

assignments.name: Trace
assignments.rationale: Use Computer substitutes for Gather Information while a computer network is available, turning computer access into information-gathering capability.

assignments.name: Acute Senses
assignments.rationale: Any Perception check can be rerolled, with the second result required.

assignments.name: Barter
assignments.rationale: Persuasion checks made to haggle can be rerolled, with the second result required.

assignments.name: Expert Tracker
assignments.rationale: Tracking while moving at normal speed no longer imposes the normal Survival penalty.

assignments.name: Hidden Movement
assignments.rationale: Moving at normal speed no longer penalizes Stealth checks.

assignments.name: Improved Initiative
assignments.rationale: Initiative checks can be rerolled, with the second result required.

assignments.name: Improved Stealth
assignments.rationale: Stealth checks can be rerolled, with the second result required.

assignments.name: Keen Shot
assignments.rationale: Ranged attacks ignore the normal attack penalty from ordinary concealment.

assignments.name: Uncanny Dodge I
assignments.rationale: The user retains Dexterity to Reflex Defense while flat-footed or attacked from hiding unless immobilized.

assignments.name: Uncanny Dodge II
assignments.rationale: The user cannot be flanked.

assignments.name: Evasion
assignments.rationale: Area attacks deal half damage on a hit and no damage on a miss.

assignments.name: Extreme Effort
assignments.rationale: Two swift actions grant a +5 bonus to one Strength check or Strength-based skill check in the same round.

assignments.name: Fringe Savant
assignments.rationale: A natural 20 on a skill check during an encounter generates a temporary Force Point.

assignments.name: Jury-Rigger
assignments.rationale: Mechanics checks for jury-rigged repairs can be rerolled, with the second result required.

assignments.name: Long Stride
assignments.rationale: Speed increases while in light or no armor, including natural fly, climb, and swim speeds.

assignments.name: Sprint
assignments.rationale: The Run action moves up to five times speed instead of four times.

assignments.name: Surefooted
assignments.rationale: Difficult terrain no longer reduces the user's speed.

assignments.name: Armor Mastery
assignments.rationale: Proficient armor permits one additional point of Dexterity bonus to apply through its maximum Dexterity limit.

assignments.name: Armored Defense
assignments.rationale: Reflex Defense uses the better of heroic level or armor bonus while wearing proficient armor.

assignments.name: Battle Analysis
assignments.rationale: A swift Knowledge (tactics) check reveals which visible allies and enemies are at half hit points or less.

assignments.name: Cover Fire
assignments.rationale: Making a pistol or rifle attack grants nearby allies a Reflex Defense bonus until the next turn.

assignments.name: Demolitionist
assignments.rationale: Explosives handled with Mechanics gain additional damage dice, stacking with repeated selections.

assignments.name: Draw Fire
assignments.rationale: A swift Persuasion check can force nearby enemies to attack the user instead of nearby allies until the next turn.

assignments.name: Expert Grappler
assignments.rationale: Grapple attacks gain a +2 competence bonus.

assignments.name: Gun Club
assignments.rationale: Ranged weapons can be used as clubs in melee without penalty, and bayonet-equipped rifles can function as double weapons.

assignments.name: Harm's Way
assignments.rationale: A swift action shields an adjacent ally by redirecting attacks against that ally to the user until the next turn.

assignments.name: Improved Armored Defense
assignments.rationale: Reflex Defense can combine heroic level with half armor bonus, or use full armor bonus, whichever is higher.

assignments.name: Indomitable
assignments.rationale: Once per day a swift action moves the user five positive steps on the condition track, with additional selections adding uses.

assignments.name: Juggernaut
assignments.rationale: Proficient armor no longer reduces normal speed or Run distance.

assignments.name: Melee Smash
assignments.rationale: All melee attacks deal +1 damage.

assignments.name: Second Skin
assignments.rationale: Proficient armor grants +1 additional Reflex armor bonus and +1 Fortitude equipment bonus.

assignments.name: Stunning Strike
assignments.rationale: A melee hit that meets or exceeds Damage Threshold moves the target one additional step down the condition track.

assignments.name: Penetrating Attack
assignments.rationale: A selected proficient weapon scope treats target Damage Reduction as 5 lower on successful attacks.

assignments.name: Tough as Nails
assignments.rationale: The user gains one additional use of second wind per day.

assignments.name: Weapon Specialization
assignments.rationale: A selected proficient weapon scope gains a persistent +2 damage bonus.

assignments.name: Disciplined Strike
assignments.rationale: Area-effect Force powers can exclude a Wisdom-scaled number of targets from their effects.

assignments.name: Telekinetic Power
assignments.rationale: A natural 20 on specified telekinetic Force powers immediately grants a second free use of that power.

assignments.name: Telekinetic Savant
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a swift action recovers one spent listed telekinetic Force power without spending a Force Point, with added uses from repeated selections.

assignments.name: Damage Reduction 10
assignments.rationale: A Force Point standard action grants DR 10 for one minute.

assignments.name: Dark Presence
assignments.rationale: A standard action grants the user and nearby allies a Force bonus to all defenses for the encounter while they remain in range.

assignments.name: Equilibrium
assignments.rationale: A Force Point swift action removes all debilitating conditions from the user and returns them to normal state.

assignments.name: Force Focus
assignments.rationale: A full-round Use the Force check recovers one spent Force power.

assignments.name: Force Perception
assignments.rationale: Use the Force substitutes for Perception for surprise, enemy detection, deception, and influence checks and inherits eligible rerolls.

assignments.name: Force Pilot
assignments.rationale: Use the Force substitutes for Pilot checks and inherits eligible Pilot rerolls.

assignments.name: Force Recovery
assignments.rationale: Second wind healing gains additional d6s based on the number of Force Points currently possessed.

assignments.name: Foresight
assignments.rationale: A Force Point rerolls Initiative with the better result kept, and a natural 20 on that reroll refunds the Force Point.

assignments.name: Gauge Force Potential
assignments.rationale: A standard Use the Force check against Will reveals Force Sensitivity, known Force-power count, and current Force Points.

assignments.name: Power of the Dark Side
assignments.rationale: When spending a Force Point to modify an attack roll, an extra bonus die can be rolled and the best result kept at the cost of increasing Dark Side Score.

assignments.name: Revenge
assignments.rationale: When a qualifying ally is killed or reduced to 0 HP in sight, the user gains encounter-long attack and damage bonuses.

assignments.name: Swift Power
assignments.rationale: Once per day a Force power that normally takes a move or standard action can instead be used as a swift action.

assignments.name: Visions
assignments.rationale: A Force Point swift action modifies farseeing to view a target's past or future instead of the present.

assignments.name: Adept Spellcaster
assignments.rationale: A Force power can be deliberately slowed to a full-round activation in exchange for a Use the Force reroll.

assignments.name: Force Cloak
assignments.rationale: A swift action creates a Force bubble that blocks electronic surveillance, sensors, and communications while maintained.

assignments.name: Elusive Dogfighter
assignments.rationale: Winning the opposed Pilot check in a dogfight imposes a severe attack penalty on engaged enemy pilots.

assignments.name: Expert Gunner
assignments.rationale: Vehicle-weapon attack rolls gain +1.

assignments.name: Full Throttle
assignments.rationale: The user can take 10 on Pilot checks to increase speed, and all-out movement reaches five times normal speed.

assignments.name: Juke
assignments.rationale: Fighting defensively while piloting grants the vehicle a +5 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense even when attacking.

assignments.name: Keep It Together
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a piloted vehicle can ignore the condition-track loss from damage meeting its Damage Threshold.

assignments.name: System Hit
assignments.rationale: Damaging a vehicle for at least its Damage Threshold moves it one additional step down the condition track.

assignments.name: Vehicular Evasion
assignments.rationale: A moving, enabled vehicle takes half damage from a hit area attack and no damage on a miss.

assignments.name: Hunter's Mark
assignments.rationale: An aimed ranged hit moves the target one step down the condition track in addition to damage.

assignments.name: Hunter's Target
assignments.rationale: A free-action designation grants class-level bonus damage on every successful melee or ranged hit against that opponent for the encounter.

assignments.name: Nowhere to Hide
assignments.rationale: Gather Information checks made to locate a specific individual can be rerolled.

assignments.name: Relentless
assignments.rationale: Effects originating from the designated Hunter's Target cannot move the user down the condition track.

assignments.name: Ruthless Negotiator
assignments.rationale: Persuasion checks made to haggle a bounty can be rerolled and the better result kept.

assignments.name: Attract Minion
assignments.rationale: The talent attracts a loyal nonheroic minion whose level scales from the user's heroic level; repeat selections add additional minions.

assignments.name: Impel Ally I
assignments.rationale: A swift action immediately grants one ally movement up to normal speed.

assignments.name: Impel Ally II
assignments.rationale: Two swift actions immediately grant one ally a standard or move action.

assignments.name: Inspire Fear I
assignments.rationale: Equal-or-lower-level opponents suffer penalties on attacks, opposed skills, and Force-power activation checks targeting the user.

assignments.name: Inspire Fear II
assignments.rationale: Inspire Fear's penalty increases to -2.

assignments.name: Inspire Fear III
assignments.rationale: Inspire Fear's penalty increases to -5.

assignments.name: Notorious
assignments.rationale: When undisguised, Persuasion checks made to intimidate can be rerolled and the better result kept.

assignments.name: Shared Notoriety
assignments.rationale: Minions invoking the user's name can reroll Persuasion intimidation checks, taking the second result.

assignments.name: Controlled Burst
assignments.rationale: Autofire and Burst Fire attack penalties are reduced, and braced autofire-only weapons can eliminate the penalty entirely.

assignments.name: Greater Devastating Attack
assignments.rationale: A chosen proficient weapon scope treats the target's Damage Threshold as 10 lower on successful attacks.

assignments.name: Greater Penetrating Attack
assignments.rationale: A chosen proficient weapon scope treats the target's Damage Reduction as 10 lower on successful attacks.

assignments.name: Greater Weapon Focus
assignments.rationale: A chosen proficient weapon scope gains +1 attack, stacking with Weapon Focus.

assignments.name: Multiattack Proficiency (heavy weapons)
assignments.rationale: Full attacks with heavy weapons reduce the multiple-attack penalty, with repeated selections reducing it further.

assignments.name: Multiattack Proficiency (rifles)
assignments.rationale: Full attacks with rifles reduce the multiple-attack penalty, with repeated selections reducing it further.

assignments.name: Channel Aggression
assignments.rationale: After hitting a flanked or Dexterity-denied target, a Force Point free action adds class-level-scaled bonus damage.

assignments.name: Channel Anger
assignments.rationale: A Force Point swift action enters a Constitution-scaled rage that boosts melee attack and damage rolls, then imposes a condition-track cost.

assignments.name: Crippling Strike
assignments.rationale: A Force Point spent on a critical hit halves the target's speed until it is fully healed.

assignments.name: Embrace the Dark Side
assignments.rationale: Dark-side Force-power activation checks may be rerolled, while selecting the talent permanently bars light-side Force powers.

assignments.name: Attune Weapon
assignments.rationale: A Force Point full-round action permanently attunes one melee weapon to grant the user an attack bonus while wielding it.

assignments.name: Empower Weapon
assignments.rationale: A Force Point full-round action permanently empowers one melee weapon to deal an extra damage die for the user.

assignments.name: Force Power Adept
assignments.rationale: For one selected Force power, spending a Force Point allows two Use the Force checks with the better result kept.

assignments.name: Force Talisman
assignments.rationale: A Force Point full-round action creates a talisman granting +1 to one selected defense while carried.

assignments.name: Force Treatment
assignments.rationale: Use the Force substitutes for Treat Injury, inherits eligible rerolls, and permits several treatments without normal medical gear.

assignments.name: Fortified Body
assignments.rationale: The user becomes immune to disease, poison, and radiation.

assignments.name: Greater Force Talisman
assignments.rationale: A Force Point full-round action creates a talisman granting +1 to Reflex, Fortitude, and Will Defense while carried.

assignments.name: Debilitating Shot
assignments.rationale: An aimed ranged hit moves the target one step down the condition track in addition to normal damage.

assignments.name: Deceptive Shot
assignments.rationale: Two swift actions make a Deception check against Will to deny one nearby target its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense against the user's attacks until next turn.

assignments.name: Improved Quick Draw
assignments.rationale: A pistol can be drawn and fired during a surprise round even when the user is surprised.

assignments.name: Knockdown Shot
assignments.rationale: An aimed ranged hit knocks a size-qualified target prone in addition to damage.

assignments.name: Multiattack Proficiency (pistols)
assignments.rationale: Full attacks with pistols reduce the multiple-attack penalty, with repeated selections reducing it further.

assignments.name: Ranged Disarm
assignments.rationale: The user can perform disarm attempts with ranged attacks without suffering the normal free counterattack on failure.

assignments.name: Trigger Work
assignments.rationale: Rapid Shot attack penalties are eliminated.

assignments.name: Ataru
assignments.rationale: Lightsaber damage can use Dexterity instead of Strength, including doubled Dexterity when wielding two-handed.

assignments.name: Djem So
assignments.rationale: Once per round after being hit by a melee attack, a Force Point reaction makes an immediate counterattack.

assignments.name: Force Fortification
assignments.rationale: A Force Point reaction converts an incoming critical hit into normal damage.

assignments.name: Greater Weapon Focus (Lightsabers)
assignments.rationale: Lightsaber melee attack rolls gain +1, stacking with Weapon Focus.

assignments.name: Greater Weapon Specialization (Lightsabers)
assignments.rationale: Lightsaber melee damage gains an additional +2 bonus, stacking with Weapon Specialization.

assignments.name: Jar'Kai
assignments.rationale: Wielding two lightsabers doubles the Reflex deflection bonus from Lightsaber Defense.

assignments.name: Juyo
assignments.rationale: A Force Point swift action designates one enemy for the encounter and grants a better-result reroll on the first attack against that enemy each round.

assignments.name: Makashi
assignments.rationale: With one one-handed lightsaber, Lightsaber Defense's deflection bonus increases by 2 up to its cap.

assignments.name: Multiattack Proficiency (lightsabers)
assignments.rationale: Full attacks with lightsabers reduce the multiple-attack penalty, with repeated selections reducing it further.

assignments.name: Niman
assignments.rationale: Wielding a lightsaber grants +1 Reflex Defense and +1 Will Defense.

assignments.name: Shien
assignments.rationale: Redirect Shot ranged attacks gain +5 to the attack roll.

assignments.name: Shii-Cho
assignments.rationale: Repeated Block/Deflect attempts impose only -2 per prior use instead of -5.

assignments.name: Sokan
assignments.rationale: The user can take 10 on tumbling under pressure, and occupied/threatened squares no longer increase tumble movement cost.

assignments.name: Soresu
assignments.rationale: Failed Use the Force checks for Block or Deflect can be rerolled.

assignments.name: Trakata
assignments.rationale: Two swift actions use Deception to feint in combat by rapidly deactivating and reigniting the lightsaber.

assignments.name: Vaapad
assignments.rationale: Lightsaber attacks threaten critical hits on natural 19–20 while retaining normal automatic-hit rules.

assignments.name: Deployment Tactics
assignments.rationale: A move-action tactics check grants the user and allies either improved attacks against flanked foes or improved Reflex Defense against attacks of opportunity.

assignments.name: One for the Team

assignments.name: Nowhere to Run
assignments.rationale: A withdrawing Hunter's Target provokes an attack of opportunity once per turn.

assignments.name: Omens
assignments.rationale: An ally's natural 1 or 20 grants a short-lived choice of attack accuracy or Reflex Defense.

assignments.name: Tag
assignments.rationale: Damaging the Hunter's Target grants all allies +2 on their next attack against it.

assignments.name: Target Visions
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter enemy movement within 6 squares triggers a reaction melee or ranged attack.

assignments.name: Temporal Awareness
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter an enemy attack triggers reaction movement up to speed.

assignments.name: Watch This
assignments.rationale: A piloted vehicle can safely enter/share the space of a much larger vehicle without collision.

assignments.name: Bodyguard I
assignments.rationale: Once per turn an adjacent attracted minion can receive an attack redirected from the user as a reaction.

assignments.name: Dash and Blast
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter dual pistols combine double-speed movement with one ranged attack from each pistol.

assignments.name: Impel Ally III
assignments.rationale: Three swift actions over consecutive turns grant one ally an immediate standard and move action.

assignments.name: Ranged Flank
assignments.rationale: A swift designation lets pistol/rifle positioning count as adjacent for flanking one target at range.

assignments.name: Shelter
assignments.rationale: Adjacency to a minion grants a cover bonus to Reflex Defense.

assignments.name: Tactical Superiority
assignments.rationale: Two swift actions let two allies move 2 squares as reactions without provoking.

assignments.name: Tactical Withdrawal
assignments.rationale: Two swift actions let nearby allies use Withdraw as a swift action through the next turn.

assignments.name: Terrify
assignments.rationale: A standard Persuasion fear check forces an Inspire Fear target to spend movement fleeing or suffer a doubled fear penalty.

assignments.name: Unsavory Reputation
assignments.rationale: Nearby opponents at half HP or less suffer encounter-long fear penalties to attacks and skills.

assignments.name: Urgency
assignments.rationale: Three swift actions over consecutive turns increase all visible allies' speed by 2 for one round.

assignments.name: Guaranteed Shot
assignments.rationale: A standard single-pistol attack while dual-wielding deals heroic-level-scaled fallback damage even on a miss.

assignments.name: Hailfire
assignments.rationale: Dual pistols allow one pistol to make an autofire attack as a standard action.

assignments.name: Twin Shot
assignments.rationale: Dual pistols add +2 damage when using Rapid Shot.

assignments.name: Advantageous Positioning
assignments.rationale: A flanked opponent is treated as flat-footed against the user.

assignments.name: Deadly Repercussions
assignments.rationale: Defeating or bottoming a target imposes a short-lived attack penalty on visible opponents.

assignments.name: Get Some Distance
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a standard melee attack is followed by full-speed movement away without provoking.

assignments.name: Murderous Arts I
assignments.rationale: An attack that moves a target down the condition track also deals 1d6 extra damage.

assignments.name: Murderous Arts II
assignments.rationale: All successful attacks against a marked opponent gain one extra damage die.

assignments.name: Ruthless
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter defeating or bottoming a foe immediately grants a bonus standard action.

assignments.name: Shift
assignments.rationale: A move action moves one square without provoking.

assignments.name: Sniping Assassin
assignments.rationale: Non-point-blank ranged attacks gain half-class-level bonus damage.

assignments.name: Sniping Marksman
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a non-point-blank ranged attack ignores armor bonus to Reflex Defense.

assignments.name: Sniping Master
assignments.rationale: A distant target can be aimed at with only one swift action.

assignments.name: Improved Manipulating Strike
assignments.rationale: A successful Manipulating Strike expands control from the target's swift action to its move action.

assignments.name: Manipulating Strike
assignments.rationale: After non-area damage, a Persuasion-vs-Will check determines the target's next swift action.

assignments.name: Pulling the Strings
assignments.rationale: A standard Persuasion-vs-Will check moves the target toward a chosen safe route and enables an immediate attack against it.

assignments.name: Cunning Distraction
assignments.rationale: A successful feint immediately grants half-speed reaction movement.

assignments.name: Damaging Deception
assignments.rationale: A standard Deception-vs-Will check makes the next allied attack against the target deal two extra damage dice.

assignments.name: Distracting Shout
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a reaction Deception check can replace an ally's defense for an incoming attack without lowering a better defense.

assignments.name: Improved Soft Cover
assignments.rationale: A swift action adjacent to another creature grants a temporary cover bonus to Reflex Defense.

assignments.name: Innocuous
assignments.rationale: A swift Deception-vs-Will check imposes -5 on the target's attacks against the user.

assignments.name: Treacherous
assignments.rationale: A reaction sidestep redirects an incoming attack to an adjacent creature, subject to normal opportunity attacks.

assignments.name: Bloodthirsty
assignments.rationale: Coup de grace compresses to a move action, and a successful kill grants allies an encounter-long morale attack bonus.

assignments.name: Fight to the Death
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a swift action heals all nearby allies by heroic level.

assignments.name: Raider's Frenzy
assignments.rationale: An ally damaging a target triggers class-scaled damage bonuses for all visible allies against that target.

assignments.name: Raider's Surge
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a standard social check forces affected enemies to withdraw or suffer an encounter-long attack penalty.

assignments.name: Savage Reputation
assignments.rationale: Nearby opponents suffer a constant mind-affecting fear penalty to attacks.

assignments.name: Take Them Alive
assignments.rationale: The user or nearby allies may convert a 0-HP takedown into stable stun-style incapacitation.

assignments.name: Confounding Attack
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter Uncanny Instincts can become an immediate counterattack, with melee hits optionally swapping positions.

assignments.name: Double Up
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter Seize the Moment can become an immediate attack whose damage combines with the ally's for DR/SR/threshold resolution.

assignments.name: Find an Opening
assignments.rationale: Seize the Moment can instead prepare aiming as a single swift action on the next turn.

assignments.name: Opportunistic Defense
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter Uncanny Instincts can become +5 Reflex Defense through the next turn.

assignments.name: Preternatural Senses
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a reaction adds half class level to one chosen defense.

assignments.name: Seize the Moment
assignments.rationale: Once per round an ally damaging an opponent grants the user a swift action as a reaction.

assignments.name: Tangle Up
assignments.rationale: A standard non-area attack deals half damage but removes the target's next move action.

assignments.name: Uncanny Instincts
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter taking damage triggers one-square reaction movement without provoking.

assignments.name: Close Maneuvering
assignments.rationale: A swift target designation prevents that target's opportunity attacks against the user's movement if adjacency is maintained.

assignments.name: Gradual Resistance
assignments.rationale: After suffering damage from a Force power, the user gains +2 to all defenses against that same power for the encounter.

assignments.name: Guiding Strikes
assignments.rationale: After lightsaber damage, a swift action grants adjacent allies +2 melee accuracy against that target through the next turn.

assignments.name: Immovable
assignments.rationale: A swift defensive stance imposes -5 on attempts to move the user involuntarily.

assignments.name: Reap Retribution
assignments.rationale: Taking Force-power damage marks its user for +2 damage from the character for the rest of the encounter.

assignments.name: Recall
assignments.rationale: A Force Point spent to recover a Force power recovers two powers instead of one.

assignments.name: Assault Gambit
assignments.rationale: A standard action pits an ally and enemy in opposed Initiative; the winner immediately attacks the loser.

assignments.name: Direct Fire
assignments.rationale: A swift designation lets one ally ignore one target's cover through the next turn.

assignments.name: Face the Foe
assignments.rationale: Having no cover from a target grants +1 morale attack accuracy against that target.

assignments.name: Lead From the Front
assignments.rationale: Ranged damage without cover grants allies attack and opposed-Initiative bonuses against the same target.

assignments.name: Precise Redirect
assignments.rationale: A successful redirected blaster bolt deals one extra damage die.

assignments.name: Find Openings
assignments.rationale: Being missed sets up +2 morale accuracy on the user's next attack.

assignments.name: Hit the Deck
assignments.rationale: Allies inside the user's area attacks take no damage on a miss and half on a hit.

assignments.name: Lure Closer
assignments.rationale: A move-action Deception-vs-Will mind effect forces an enemy to move safely toward the user.

assignments.name: Unwavering Ally
assignments.rationale: A swift designation makes an ally immune to flat-footed/Dexterity-denial effects through the next turn.

assignments.name: Aggressive Surge
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, second wind immediately enables a free charge attack.

assignments.name: Blast Back
assignments.rationale: Area-attack damage triggers an immediate reaction counterattack against the source.

assignments.name: Fade Away
assignments.rationale: Taking damage triggers half-speed reaction movement without provoking.

assignments.name: Second Strike
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a missed single attack enables safe movement and a second attack against another target, with extra uses scaling from Combat Reflexes.

assignments.name: Swerve
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter an incoming attack of opportunity is negated and followed by safe movement; Combat Reflexes can scale uses.

assignments.name: Trick Step
assignments.rationale: A swift opposed Initiative check can make the target flat-footed to the user's next attack, with failure creating reciprocal risk.

assignments.name: Ambush Specialist
assignments.rationale: The first combat round counts as a surprise round and a prime target can be designated for encounter-long attack accuracy.

assignments.name: Keep It Going
assignments.rationale: Dropping the prime target immediately retargets the prime-target designation.

assignments.name: Keep Them Reeling
assignments.rationale: A swift opposed Initiative check makes the prime target flat-footed to all the user's attacks that turn.

assignments.name: Perceptive Ambusher
assignments.rationale: Prime Target gains a +5 Perception bonus for the encounter.

assignments.name: Spring the Trap
assignments.rationale: Winning initiative as a full team automatically grants a surprise round.

assignments.name: Shield Gauntlet Defense
assignments.rationale: An active shield gauntlet grants a once-per-turn reaction +2 Reflex defense against one ranged attack.

assignments.name: Shield Gauntlet Deflect
assignments.rationale: A reaction Use the Force check can negate ranged attacks with a shield gauntlet; a Force Point extends protection to an adjacent ally.

assignments.name: Siang Lance Mastery
assignments.rationale: A siang lance is treated as a rifle and gains +1 attack accuracy.

assignments.name: Concentrate All Fire
assignments.rationale: Aiding an ally's vehicle-weapon attack adds one damage die when that attack hits.

assignments.name: Escort Pilot
assignments.rationale: Adjacent allied vehicles both gain +10 Damage Threshold.

assignments.name: Lose Pursuit
assignments.rationale: Adjacent wingmen gain +5 Pilot checks to avoid being pulled into dogfights by opportunity attacks.

assignments.name: Run Interference
assignments.rationale: Vehicular Combat can be used reactively to negate an attack against an adjacent allied vehicle.

assignments.name: Wingman Retribution
assignments.rationale: Damage to an adjacent allied vehicle triggers a reaction vehicle-weapon counterattack against the attacker.

assignments.name: Recruit Enemy
assignments.rationale: A would-be lethal hit can become nonlethal damage plus a condition step and a Persuasion-vs-Will recruitment effect.

assignments.name: Team Recruiting
assignments.rationale: Recruit Enemy can trigger when an ally, not only the user, would kill the target.

assignments.name: Bigger Bang
assignments.rationale: Improvised grenades gain one additional damage die.

assignments.name: Black Market Buyer
assignments.rationale: Locating a black-market seller automatically succeeds without Gather Information.

assignments.name: Capture Droid
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a standard Mechanics-vs-Will action repairs a disabled enemy droid and temporarily converts it to an ally.

assignments.name: Custom Model
assignments.rationale: Improvised devices can receive one Tech Specialist modification.

assignments.name: Excellent Kit
assignments.rationale: Purchased gear gains extra HP/DR and gives allies a Mechanics bonus when working on it.

assignments.name: Improved Jury-Rig
assignments.rationale: Jury-rig compresses to a standard action, automatically succeeds, and restores an extra condition step.

assignments.name: Improvised Device
assignments.rationale: A Mechanics check and spare parts create temporary level-valued equipment.

assignments.name: Just What Is Needed
assignments.rationale: Successful repairs restore an extra 1d8 HP, including when the user aids an ally's repair.

assignments.name: Only the Finest
assignments.rationale: Black-market purchases can include Tech Specialist modifications at no extra base value.

assignments.name: Right Gear for the Job
assignments.rationale: A reaction gives an ally +5 on an untrained skill and temporary trained status for trained-only applications.

assignments.name: Bunker Blaster
assignments.rationale: Adjacent cover lets the user aim at a target as a move action.

assignments.name: Defensive Measures
assignments.rationale: Enemies treat the user's Safe Zone as difficult terrain.

assignments.name: Enhance Cover
assignments.rationale: A swift action upgrades one ally's existing cover to improved cover through the next turn.

assignments.name: Escort Fighter
assignments.rationale: A swift designation lets an adjacent ally mirror the user's movement while staying adjacent.

assignments.name: Launch Point
assignments.rationale: Leaving the Safe Zone grants +2 attack accuracy for the rest of that turn.

assignments.name: Obscuring Defenses
assignments.rationale: Enemies firing into the Safe Zone suffer -2 attack rolls.

assignments.name: Relocate
assignments.rationale: A swift dismissal of the Safe Zone gives former occupants +2 speed until the next turn.

assignments.name: Safe Passage
assignments.rationale: A move action grants an ally reaction movement; enemy opportunity attacks during it can be countered by the user.

assignments.name: Safe Zone
assignments.rationale: A standard action establishes a persistent area granting allies Fortitude and Will defense bonuses.

assignments.name: Zone of Recuperation
assignments.rationale: Second wind inside the Safe Zone heals additional class-level hit points.

assignments.name: Engineer
assignments.rationale: Mechanics training plus a 25% reduction in vehicle-system installation time improves technical modification throughput.

assignments.name: Fast Repairs
assignments.rationale: Jury-rigging grants temporary hit points equal to the Mechanics check, directly adding vehicle/object durability.

assignments.name: Force Reflexes
assignments.rationale: A Force Point rerolls a starship-maneuver Pilot check and keeps the better result.

assignments.name: Hot Wire
assignments.rationale: Mechanics substitutes for Use Computer to improve access and inherits applicable Use Computer rerolls.

assignments.name: Begin Attack Run
assignments.rationale: A swift target designation increases squadron attack-run accuracy against one target.

assignments.name: Blind Spot
assignments.rationale: Repeated swift opposed Pilot checks maintain close positioning that boosts the user's attacks and penalizes the target's attacks.

assignments.name: Close Scrape
assignments.rationale: A reaction Pilot check can convert a vehicle critical hit into a normal hit.

assignments.name: Crippling Hit
assignments.rationale: Condition-track damage to a vehicle can disable one major system until full recovery.

assignments.name: Great Shot
assignments.rationale: Vehicle-weapon range is treated as one category closer for attack modifiers.

assignments.name: Improved Attack Run
assignments.rationale: Attack runs no longer require straight-line movement.

assignments.name: Quick Fix
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a non-disabled object or vehicle may be jury-rigged, gaining the normal recovery/durability effects.

assignments.name: Synchronized Fire
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter coordinated weapon hits combine damage before SR/DR and threshold resolution.

assignments.name: Wingman
assignments.rationale: A swift Pilot check grants a nearby allied pilot +5 on dogfight-related opposed Pilot checks.

assignments.name: Combined Fire
assignments.rationale: A swift designation improves weapon-battery damage scaling against one target and can enable tactical-fire attacks.

assignments.name: Fleet Deployment
assignments.rationale: A full-round command immediately moves class-level many visible vehicles by their speeds.

assignments.name: It's a Trap!
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a reaction grants any visible vehicle pilot an immediate move action.

assignments.name: Legendary Commander
assignments.rationale: Capital-ship command improves Reflex Defense, gunner damage scaling, and generic crew quality.

assignments.name: Regroup
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a standard command moves every squadron vehicle one positive condition step.

assignments.name: Squadron Maneuvers
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a standard action shares one owned pilot/gunner talent with the squadron for the encounter.

assignments.name: Squadron Tactics
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter using a starship maneuver grants the whole squadron one use of that maneuver next turn.

assignments.name: Malkite Techniques
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter a standard action poisons a slashing/piercing weapon; the toxin repeatedly damages and moves the victim down the condition track until cured or it misses.

assignments.name: Modify Poison
assignments.rationale: A life-sciences check changes a poison's delivery method without changing its effects.

assignments.name: Numbing Poison
assignments.rationale: Any poisoned target automatically loses its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense while poisoned.

assignments.name: Undetectable Poison
assignments.rationale: Poisons used by the character are harder to cure with Treat Injury.

assignments.name: Vicious Poison
assignments.rationale: The character's poisons gain +2 attack accuracy against Fortitude Defense.

assignments.name: Drain Knowledge
assignments.rationale: A Force Point and Use the Force check steal temporary skill training/focus or specific information, inflict a persistent condition, and increase Dark Side Score.

assignments.name: Ignore Damage Reduction
assignments.rationale: A sufficiently damaging unarmed attack ignores the target's Damage Reduction completely.

assignments.name: Teräs Käsi Basics
assignments.rationale: Unarmed attacks deal one additional damage die.

assignments.name: Teräs Käsi Mastery
assignments.rationale: An all-unarmed full attack compresses from a full-round action to a standard action.

assignments.name: Unarmed Counterstrike
assignments.rationale: A successful Unarmed Parry immediately grants a reaction unarmed counterattack.

assignments.name: Unarmed Parry
assignments.rationale: While fighting defensively, a reaction opposed unarmed attack roll can negate an incoming melee attack.

assignments.name: Stolen Form
assignments.rationale: The character acquires the benefits and prerequisite identity of one chosen Lightsaber Forms talent.

assignments.name: Hard Target
assignments.rationale: Second wind changes from a swift action to a reaction.

claudeExecutionContract.reason: Phase 12-2 is design authority only until all 876 existing-tag talents are audited and owner authorizes execution.
